about_the_game:
Cameraman: The Pilot Episode is a psychological horror game that lets you bend time and manipulate gravity to solve puzzles and survive. Inspired by 80's British television, M.C. Escher, and the Backrooms, you’ll explore ever-changing rooms and spaces that twist familiar locations into something far more sinister.

Story

Travelling to a strange pocket dimension as part of a ground-breaking experiment, Cameraman must navigate a surreal landscape where time warps and gravity defies logic. Re-living the tragedies of his past, Cameraman must uncover the lost secrets of one fateful day in his life before his psyche breaks.

As you delve deeper into this fractured world, you'll distance yourself from the tight grip of sanity. Constantly questioning what’s real and whether something is watching from the darkness. Uncover hidden truths and shadows of the past as the harrowing events unfold once more. But beware... This dimension reacts to it's inhabitants and on this journey it hosts a broken man.

Key Features

  • British Analog Horror: On the other side of the portal, Cameraman experiences the familiar: an old UK television studio. You will find outdated tech, eerily empty studios and dusty office spaces.

  • Gravity-Based Puzzles: Walk on walls and ceilings to navigate the puzzling path of the other side.

  • Camcorder POV: Through an 80's style camera lens you will view the mysteries beyond our world. Complete with artifacting, stuttering glitches and the classic timer.

  • Rewind Time: Rewind specific objects to traverse the environment's challenges, your path forward may depend on it.

  • Live Action Sequences: Where would a TV News Studio be without it's host? Experience news reports in live action sequences on TV's around the level.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel 8th Generation or AMD Ryzen 2000 series
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2070
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel 11th Generation or AMD Ryzen 5000 series
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3070 or higher
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Cameraman: The Pilot Episode is a psychological horror game. Manipulate time and gravity to solve puzzles in ever-changing, twisted spaces. With only a VHS camcorder, uncover dark secrets, face unseen anomalies, and navigate an uncharted dimension where reality unravels.
